Rendered in every variant on the catalogue (`deno task build:demos`, then `demo/index.html`). Guides: [Getting started](../UI-Getting-Started.md) · [rAPId integration](../UI-Rapid.md) · [Theming](../UI-Theming.md).

## Functions

### `Rating`

```ts
Rating(props: RatingProps): Html
```

Stars. Interactive, it is a real radiogroup — visually hidden radios,
star labels, arrows move the pick like any radio group — and the fill
is pure CSS (the stars sit reversed in the DOM so the sibling
combinator can colour "every star up to the picked one"). Read-only, it
is an image with the value as its name, halves included. Nothing here
needs the script.

## Types

### `RatingSize`

- `"sm"`
- `"md"`
- `"lg"`

### `RatingProps`

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | yes |  |
| `name` | `string` |  | Field name; the picked star submits as its number. |
| `value` | `number` |  | Current value, 0–`max`; a half (4.5) shows as a half star when `readOnly`. |
| `max` | `number` |  |  |
| `readOnly` | `boolean` |  | Display only: no inputs, a `role="img"` with the value as its name. |
| `size` | `RatingSize` |  |  |
| `label` | `string` | yes | The group's accessible name ("Your rating", "Average rating"). |
| `labels` | `string[]` |  | Per-star accessible names; default "N of max stars". |
| `clearable` | `boolean` |  | Clicking the picked star again clears the rating (rating.js). |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `attrs` | `Attrs` |  |  |

## Usage

Each example as the rAPId call and the HTML it renders — the markup a plain page writes by hand. Icons are inline SVG in the real output; they are shortened to `<svg …>…</svg>` here.

### Ask for a rating in a form

A real radio group: arrows move the pick, the form posts `score=4`. `clearable` lets a second click on the picked star clear it.

```ts
Rating({ id: "score", name: "score", label: "Your rating", value: 4, clearable: true })
```

```html
<fieldset class="rating rating--md" id="score" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Your rating" data-rating="" data-rating-clearable="">
  <legend class="sr-only">Your rating</legend>
  <input type="radio" class="rating__input sr-only" id="score-5" name="score" value="5">
  <label class="rating__label" for="score-5" title="5 of 5 stars">
    <span class="sr-only">5 of 5 stars</span>
    <span class="rating__star" aria-hidden="true">
      <svg width="20" height="20" width="2" …>…</svg>
    </span>
  </label>
  <input type="radio" class="rating__input sr-only" id="score-4" name="score" value="4" checked="">
  <label class="rating__label" for="score-4" title="4 of 5 stars">
    <span class="sr-only">4 of 5 stars</span>
    <span class="rating__star" aria-hidden="true">
      <svg width="20" height="20" width="2" …>…</svg>
    </span>
  </label>
  <input type="radio" class="rating__input sr-only" id="score-3" name="score" value="3">
  <label class="rating__label" for="score-3" title="3 of 5 stars">
    <span class="sr-only">3 of 5 stars</span>
    <span class="rating__star" aria-hidden="true">
      <svg width="20" height="20" width="2" …>…</svg>
    </span>
  </label>
  <input type="radio" class="rating__input sr-only" id="score-2" name="score" value="2">
  <label class="rating__label" for="score-2" title="2 of 5 stars">
    <span class="sr-only">2 of 5 stars</span>
    <span class="rating__star" aria-hidden="true">
      <svg width="20" height="20" width="2" …>…</svg>
    </span>
  </label>
  <input type="radio" class="rating__input sr-only" id="score-1" name="score" value="1">
  <label class="rating__label" for="score-1" title="1 of 5 stars">
    <span class="sr-only">1 of 5 stars</span>
```

### Show an average

Read-only renders an image named with the value; halves are drawn.

```ts
Rating({ id: "avg", label: "Average rating", value: 4.5, readOnly: true, size: "sm" })
```

```html
<span class="rating rating--readonly rating--sm" id="avg" role="img" aria-label="Average rating: 4.5 out of 5">
  <span class="rating__star rating__star--full" aria-hidden="true">
    <svg width="14" height="14" width="2" …>…</svg>
  </span>
  <span class="rating__star rating__star--full" aria-hidden="true">
    <svg width="14" height="14" width="2" …>…</svg>
  </span>
  <span class="rating__star rating__star--full" aria-hidden="true">
    <svg width="14" height="14" width="2" …>…</svg>
  </span>
  <span class="rating__star rating__star--full" aria-hidden="true">
    <svg width="14" height="14" width="2" …>…</svg>
  </span>
  <span class="rating__star rating__star--half" aria-hidden="true">
    <svg width="14" height="14" width="2" …>…</svg>
    <span class="rating__half">
      <svg width="14" height="14" width="2" …>…</svg>
    </span>
  </span>
</span>
```

## CSS hooks

Classes defined by `components/rating/rating.css` — structural, token-driven; override from an unlayered stylesheet (see [Theming](../UI-Theming.md)):

`.rating`, `.rating--disabled`, `.rating--lg`, `.rating--readonly`, `.rating--sm`, `.rating__half`, `.rating__input`, `.rating__label`, `.rating__star`, `.rating__star--full`, `.rating__star--half`

## Behaviour

`components/rating/rating.js` ships in `ui.js` (delegated on `document`, re-initialised after a rAPId swap).

Attributes it reads or writes: `data-rating`, `data-rating-clearable`.

Events: `rating:change`.
